BiblicalUsage: There was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Beth-lehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite. The battle at Gob was the second fight with the Philistines there, and Elhanan's blow fell on Goliath's own brother.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jaare-oregim is remembered through his son's sword: Elhanan slew the brother of Goliath, and the father who wove the loom is named because the son who fought the giant carried his name into battle.
